configurations.name: Android: Run on connected phone
configurations.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.19.10-hotspot'; $env:ANDROID_HOME="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk"; $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$env:ANDROID_HOME; $env:Path="$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:ANDROID_HOME\platform-tools;$env:ANDROID_HOME\cmdline-tools\latest\bin;$env:Path"; $device=(adb devices | Select-String '\s+device$' | Select-Object -First 1); if (-not $device) { throw 'No Android phone is connected over adb.' }; $env:ANDROID_SERIAL=($device.ToString() -split '\s+')[0]; Write-Host "Using Android device $env:ANDROID_SERIAL"; npx expo run:android --variant debug

configurations.name: Android: Run (use existing Metro)
configurations.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.19.10-hotspot'; $env:ANDROID_HOME="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk"; $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$env:ANDROID_HOME; $env:Path="$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:ANDROID_HOME\platform-tools;$env:ANDROID_HOME\cmdline-tools\latest\bin;$env:Path"; $device=(adb devices | Select-String '\s+device$' | Select-Object -First 1); if (-not $device) { throw 'No Android phone is connected over adb.' }; $env:ANDROID_SERIAL=($device.ToString() -split '\s+')[0]; Write-Host "Using Android device $env:ANDROID_SERIAL"; $metroPort=8081; $metroListening=$false; $deadline=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(2); while (-not $metroListening -and (Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { try { $metroListening=$null -ne (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $metroPort -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1) } catch {}; if (-not $metroListening) { Write-Host "Waiting for Metro on port $metroPort..."; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } }; if (-not $metroListening) { throw "Metro is not listening on port $metroPort. Start \"Web: Start Expo\" first." }; Write-Host "Using Metro on port $metroPort (--no-bundler)"; npx expo run:android --variant debug --no-bundler
